title: StrictPerfectCoefficientPackageOnSite.map
statement:
Let F be an additive finite-limit-preserving functor between module-sheaf categories, equipped with an isomorphism from F of the rank-one free module to the target rank-one free module. Every displayed termwise finite-free retraction package on a complex P transports to such a package on F(P), with the same finite ranks.

Precise quantified statement:
def StrictPerfectCoefficientPackageOnSite.map
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {D : Type u'} [Category.{v'} D]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} {K : GrothendieckTopology D}
    {R : Sheaf J RingCat.{r}} {S : Sheaf K RingCat.{r}}
    (F : SheafOfModules.{r} R ⥤ SheafOfModules.{r} S)
    [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F]
    (e : F.obj (unit R) ≅ unit S)
    {P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{r} R) ℤ}
    (p : StrictPerfectCoefficientPackageOnSite R P) :
    StrictPerfectCoefficientPackageOnSite S ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)

Notions used: [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-pur-localized-ringed-site].
